name: AbuseIPDB - Security Alerts Involving Blacklisted IPs
description: Correlates AbuseIPDB blacklisted IPs with SecurityAlert entities to identify existing security alerts that involve known abusive IP addresses. Enriches alert triage with abuse confidence scores and country of origin for faster prioritization.
query:
let BlacklistedIPs = AbuseIPDB_Blacklist_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
| where AbuseConfidenceScore >= 50
| summarize AbuseScore = max(AbuseConfidenceScore), Country = any(CountryCode) by IpAddress;
SecurityAlert
| where TimeGenerated > ago(14d)
| where Entities has '"Type":"ip"'
| mv-expand Entity = parse_json(Entities)
| where Entity.Type == 'ip'
| extend AlertIP = tostring(Entity.Address)
| where AlertIP in ((BlacklistedIPs | project IpAddress))
| join kind=inner BlacklistedIPs on $left.AlertIP == $right.IpAddress
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by SystemAlertId
| project TimeGenerated, AlertName, AlertSeverity, AlertIP, AbuseScore, Country, ProviderName, ProductName, Tactics
| order by AbuseScore desc, TimeGenerated desc
